title: Reproducibility of physical therapy interventions for groin pain: a scoping review protocol
author: Shane Malone

steps.title: Define Study Eligibility Criteria
steps.instruction: Establish inclusion and exclusion criteria based on PICO elements to identify eligible studies.

substeps.instruction: Include participants: athletes aged 16 years or older with acute onset (sudden, <6 weeks) or long-standing (≥6 weeks, Doha clinical entities) groin pain.
Include interventions: physical therapy/physiotherapy clinical management of athletes with acute onset or long-standing groin pain.

Include study types: full-text articles in English peer-reviewed journals published before June 2025, including prospective or retrospective intervention studies (case series, clinical studies, clinical trials, comparative studies, controlled clinical trials, observational studies, or RCTs).

Exclude: studies not explicitly reporting on physical therapy for the target population, opinion pieces, expert commentaries, systematic reviews, conference abstracts, narrative reviews, abstracts without full-text, and management of surgical patients.

steps.title: Execute Literature Search
steps.instruction: Search electronic bibliographic databases and reference lists for relevant articles from 01 January 1990 to July 2025.

substeps.instruction: Search MEDLINE via PubMed, CINAHL, and SPORTDiscus using MeSH terms and keywords.

Use PubMed search string: ("Groin"[Mesh]) OR (groin[Title/Abstract]) OR ("groin pain"[Title/Abstract]) OR ("groin injur*")[Title/Abstract]) OR ("acute injur*"[Title/Abstract]) OR ("athletic pubalgia"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Rehabilitation"[Mesh]) OR (rehab*[Title/Abstract]) OR ("Return to Sport"[Mesh]) OR ("Return to performance"[Title/Abstract]).
Hand-search reference lists of included articles to identify additional relevant studies.

steps.title: Screen and Select Studies
steps.instruction: Perform a multi-stage screening process to determine study eligibility.

substeps.instruction: Independently screen titles and abstracts of identified articles (Reviewers: Shane Malone and Eamonn Delahunt).
Review full-length texts of articles where eligibility is uncertain after title/abstract screening.
Consult a third reviewer (John Kiely) to resolve disagreements and facilitate consensus.

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Use a standardized Microsoft Excel data extraction sheet to collect study and intervention details.

substeps.instruction: Perform primary data extraction (Reviewer: Shane Malone).
Perform quality assurance extraction on 20% of included studies (Reviewer: Eamonn Delahunt).

Extract Study Characteristics: title, lead author/year, journal, design (Oxford UK CEBM Levels of Evidence), participant n, sex (male/female/mixed and %), age (mean, SD, range), country, injury classification, sport level (amateur/professional), treatment duration, impairment addressed (Pathomechanical, Motor-behavioural, Sensory-perceptual), and presence of maintenance program.

Extract Intervention Characteristics using TIDieR-Rehab checklist: brief name, rationale, target population, start point, materials, procedures, providers/expertise, delivery modes, location, session duration, active participation time, frequency, total length, difficulty scaling, regression/progression, needs-based personalization, preference-based personalization, protocol deviations, fidelity plan/actual, and harms monitoring/occurrence.

Extract Intervention Characteristics using CERT checklist: equipment, qualifications, individual vs group, supervised vs unsupervised, adherence measurement, motivation strategies, progression rules/process, exercise descriptions for replication, home program components, non-exercise components, adverse events, setting, general intervention description, generic vs tailored approach, starting level rules, and fidelity assessment.

steps.title: Analyze and Categorize Interventions
steps.instruction: Analyze the extracted data using Excel 2019 to evaluate the reproducibility of interventions.

substeps.instruction: Categorize interventions under Pathomechanical (Osteokinematic, Soft tissue), Motor-behavioural (Neuromuscular inhibition, Muscle-strengthening, Balance, Altered movement pattern), and Sensory-perceptual (Pain, Somatosensation).
Calculate the proportion of studies including each intervention type.
Evaluate the quality and reproducibility of interventions using the TIDieR-Rehab and CERT frameworks to describe reproducible and irreproducible core elements.
